editorialSelection: Balanced practical capture, editing and photo-library tasks. Selection reflects distinct intent and readiness, not verified volume or difficulty. All 30 complete drafts received independent review; seven held solely to honor the chosen daily ceiling.

metrics.note: No newly accessible paid/free keyword-volume dataset. Primary-source research does not measure demand. Existing small Search Console sample retained in earlier research; no new traffic or ranking outcome claimed.

sources: See three group research files and three independent review reports. General setup examples are proposed exercises, not hands-on tests.
images: 30 different licensed illustrative image sets within the new batch: six newly downloaded Pexels photographs and 24 existing assets, with visible credits and stock disclosure. Masters have a 3840px long edge and responsive variants.
appPromotion: Unchanged shared ArticleDownloadCTA with App Store and Google Play labels and honest coming-soon behavior. No invented Meluvya editing controls.
indexing: New live URLs join the existing submitted sitemap automatically. Google indexing is not confirmed; no repeat request for unchanged URLs or bypass of quotas.
